title: 初二短对话：电影与手套
source_notice: 初二普通期末公开卷具体结构已核；主卷三节5/5/5与参考键合写后10题标题冲突保留。正文地域未知、学校原版未认证；首5脚本完整而后段截断，原录音缺，不当gold。本稿为完整原创配套，未通过独立教研/学生/商用或生产验证。
instruction: 听五段短对话，每段一题，选A、B、C中的最佳答案。每段只读一遍，听后留10秒；审阅可重播。

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The beginning was a little scary, but the two brothers were so funny that I laughed through most of it.

questions.stem: How did Amy feel during most of the film?
questions.rationale: A：没有无聊；B：只适用于开头；C：大部分时间在笑

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: These gloves cost eighteen pounds. That pair costs twelve.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will take the twelve-pound pair. They fit better, and I can spend the rest on a book.

questions.stem: How much will the man pay for the gloves?
questions.rationale: A：明确选12镑那副；B：另一副价格；C：把两副相加不符只买一副

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Did you enjoy the mountain walk?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes, but we nearly lost the path. Luckily a woman walking her dog showed us the way down.

questions.stem: Who helped the woman find the path?
questions.rationale: A：未提司机；B：明确遛狗女子指路；C：未提同学

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Do you still make model planes at weekends?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Not now. I used to enjoy that, but these days I take photos of birds in the park.

questions.stem: What is the boy's hobby now?
questions.rationale: A：过去的爱好；B：未提集邮；C：these days说明当前拍鸟

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Can you help me carry these boxes?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Of course. Put the small one on the chair. I will take the heavy one, and you can carry the long one.

questions.stem: Which box will the woman carry?
questions.rationale: A：放椅子上；B：明确I will take the heavy one；C：留给男方搬
